commands.note: Curated APT syntax is targeted and tested for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. Simulate package changes before execution.
DNF is not the native package manager for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.
Ubuntu 24.04 LTS uses the util-linux 2.39 series. Common lsblk syntax is covered, but the filter option introduced in util-linux 2.40 is unavailable.
The curated common util-linux mount listing, read-only, type, and option syntax is covered for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.
The curated procps-ng free human-readable, byte, and refresh syntax is covered for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.
The curated iputils ping count, interval, numeric, and IPv6 syntax is covered for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.
The catalog exposes stable Git global invocation syntax for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS; subcommand semantics remain separately reviewable.
